data.label: include
data.reason_zh: 提出HiMeco，通过失败反思生成可复用策略与参数化技能，并跨轮指导后续交互，属方法级自改进。

scope_support.feedback_quote: HiMeco diagnoses failures in perception-exploration-planning (PEP), then compares execution attempts to derive reusable strategies and guidance for avoiding recurring errors.
scope_support.object_quote: It also abstracts interaction programs into parameterized skills, using evidence contracts and execution-based validation to determine their retention and reuse.
scope_support.persistence_quote: These strategies and skills guide subsequent interactions, with memory updated only between rounds and model parameters kept frozen.
